_doc: ENEMY IMAGE RULES (obligatorias): caminando hacia la izquierda, perfil lateral, cuerpo completo, centrado, fondo blanco puro, sin escenario/suelo/sombras. Después: quitar fondo → PNG transparente (el asset del juego).
subject: a {name} enemy for a 2D fantasy RPG battle screen{details}
pose: walking toward the LEFT, mid-stride, strict side view (profile), body and face clearly oriented to the left side of the image, weapon in hand ready to fight
mandatory: The creature faces and walks to the LEFT. Strict side profile, not three-quarter, not facing the viewer.
Full body visible from head to feet, no parts cut off.
